cards.front: Three years after menarche, a girl has persistent irregular cycles but no clinical or biochemical hyperandrogenism. Other causes have been excluded. The diagnostic follow-up plan is [___].
cards.context:
Within eight years of menarche, ultrasound and AMH are not diagnostic because normal pubertal physiology overlaps with polycystic morphology.

Adolescent diagnosis requires persistent ovulatory dysfunction and hyperandrogenism. With only one feature, treat symptoms and arrange reassessment.
